description: Source code implementing CPU fallback mechanisms for tensor operations in PyTorch, including tensor device conversions, validation, and operator handling.

methods.name: to_cpu
methods.description: Converts a vector of tensors or optional tensors to CPU, handling undefined tensors separately.

methods.name: compute_target_device
methods.description: Determines the target device for output tensors based on input tensors and tensor lists.

methods.name: validate_tensor_list
methods.description: Checks if a tensor list contains any defined tensors.

methods.name: cpu_fallback
methods.description: Performs CPU fallback for a given operator, converting inputs to CPU, calling the operator, and converting outputs back to the original device, with handling for aliasing and view operators.
